Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:46573
Court No. - 28
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 615 of 2025

Applicant :- Kiran Bisht Nee Kiran Dhauni
Opposite Party :- The State Of U.P. Thru.
The Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Nikhil Dixit,Mohd Jishan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A.for the State and perused the record.

The present petition has been filed by the applicant with limited prayer for a direction to the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknnow to decide the Case No.11163 of 2021 "State of U.P. vs.
Bhupendra Singh Bisht and others" registered as Crime No.868 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323,
506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D. P. Act, Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow expeditiously in a fixed time frame.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the charge sheet was filed in the year 2020 and even now, the charge has not been framed.
The applicant has appeared on 05.06.2025, but the trial has been delayed in the matter.

He has also referred to Section 529 of B.N.S.S., wherein it is provided that every High Court shall exercise its superintendence over the Courts of Sessions and the courts of Judicial Magistrates subordinate to it as to ensure the expeditious and proper disposal Kiran Bisht Nee Kiran Dhauni vs The State Of U.P. Thru.
